quests.title: Her Past

dialogue.t: Looking for me?
Waaah!

dialogue.sit: You really had to pop up from behind like that...?

dialogue.t: After sensing your arrival, I wanted to see how close I could get to you from behind.
Because you have nothing better to do, or...?
Hm... Is that how it seems? No different than when I was with the Fatui, then... There was never much for me to do.
The Tsaritsa only sought the power of the Moon Goddesses. I was never dispatched to seize a Gnosis or anything like that.

dialogue.sit: So what would you do to pass the time?

dialogue.t: Take walks, watch the moon, sometimes sing... But, I came to do that last one less and less after Sandrone forbade it.
Hmm? She didn't like your singing?
No. She praised it, actually. But, I had only recently joined the Fatui then, and she said my singing set the others on edge.
Because, for those not in the know, it seemed like I was about to use... some sort of power.
Oh, huh... Paimon can sort of understand that.
Oh, and there was another reason. She said she did most of her research at night, so if I sang during the day, it would disturb her attempts to catch up on sleep.

dialogue.sit: (This was the main reason, I'll bet!)

dialogue.t: So, I used to just sing outside her door at night instead. But, still. She always chased me away...

dialogue.sit: Did you get along with the others?

dialogue.t: "Get along"? Hmm... When we first met, Arlecchino did seem eager to "get along" with me.
She often showed up behind me without making a sound, like I did to you earlier. She said it was an attempt to "test" me, I believe.
I, too, attempted to join in on the game, but she always managed to spot me before I even got close.
Eventually, I resorted to using kuuvahki and managed to give her quite a scare from behind. But, she never played that game with me again after that.
(Yeah, Paimon doubts that was a "game" to the Knave at all...)
What else... Oh, The Doctor often asked me to assist in his Light Realm-related research.
I obliged him a few times, but it was so dull. "Use kuuvahki to strike this," "use kuuvahki to control that"... I stopped going after a while.

dialogue.sit: Looks like you're in a good mood today...
You spoke quite a bit about your past...

dialogue.t: Yes. Even though I've "run away from home," I do have some fond memories of it all the same.
Arlecchino and Sandrone treated me quite well, along with...

dialogue.sit: (That expression... I wonder who she's thinking about...)

dialogue.t: Give me your hand.
Rosalyne taught me... It's important to always express gratitude to others.
So, thank you for listening to me.
I believe that's enough for today.
Whoa, that was sudden!

dialogue.sit: She's remembering certain things from her past, I think...

dialogue.t: Yeah, guess you're right. Well, let's not bother her, then.

quests.description: The Damselette appears to have some interesting things to share at the Silvermoon Hall…
